record.text: BREAKING: Central banks around the world are quietly stockpiling four times as much gold as usual and are moving it out of the US, per FORTUNE
BREAKING: The White House says Melania Trump has brokered a ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine "localised to the city of Oleshky".
BREAKING: SpaceX, $SPCX, is seeking access to at least 80,000 US cell tower sites as it prepares to launch a nationwide wireless carrier, per Bloomberg
BREAKING: Iran says it will strike oil facilities, undersea cables, datacentres and AI facilities across as many as seven countries in the Gulf in the event of a fresh US-Israeli attack

BREAKING: Major U.S. banks are detecting unauthorized third-party AI agents operating inside customer accounts, with some agents attempting to take actions that appear to be independent of user instructions, per Axios
BREAKING: The U.S. and Israel have plans for new strikes on Iran after the midterms, per NYT
BREAKING: "US embassy staff and families ordered to leave Saudi Arabia, with families of embassy staff in the United Arab Emirates, Jordan, Qatar and Bahrain also ordered to leave," per AFP

Trump: "If you elected a Republican House and Senate on November 3, you're gonna get $5,000. And if we lose, you get nothing. You're gonna get nothing! If we lose, you get nothing. Make it a lot easier vote."

BREAKING: Two critical security flaws in PHP, the programming language behind much of the internet, are forcing governments to take websites offline, per the BBC.

The flaws were found by AI. Security firm Wiz called them the “most severe vulnerabilities ever discovered” by the technology.

Elon Musk says he sees $SPCX annual recurring revenue to land between $500 billion and $1 trillion by the end of 2027.

BREAKING: Anthropic’s draft IPO filing shows red-hot growth, big risks and massive computing costs, per The Wall Street Journal.

The company posted an $80.7 billion net loss in the first half of 2026.

BREAKING: Trump has revealed his new anti-fraud program set up to reward people who expose fraud with a 1% commission on the money uncovered.  "If you turn somebody in and you, let's say report and you find $1 billion, we are giving a commission to that person of 1%."
JD Vance: "Vote for the people who have solutions to lower the cost of gas, don't vote for the people who made the problem to begin with."
BREAKING: Albertans have voted to stay in Canada and not separate, CBC News has projected
BREAKING: French authorities acknowledge they have “lost control” in major cities as widespread protests, violence and unrest grip the country, prompting calls for curfews to restore order, per NBC

Russian President Vladimir Putin has proposed that he, President Trump and Chinese leader Xi Jinping meet next month to attempt to negotiate an end to the war in Ukraine that would favor Moscow, per WSJ

Anthropic says it’s committing 5% of its shares to a ‘public benefit fund’

Anthropic announced today that it’s creating a “public benefit fund” that will give the company “increased flexibility and scale” to support projects for societal good.
BREAKING: President Trump has declined to rule out declaring a national emergency related to the 2026 midterms, per Reuters
Iran urges US to accept proposal to reopen Strait of Hormuz, per Reuters

BREAKING: Chaos exploded across France on Saturday as 550,000 protesters flooded the streets, torched cars and buildings, looted from posh stores including Louis Vuitton and Hermès, and even threatened to storm the Élysée Palace, prompting Emmanuel Macron to rage: “Let them come and get me," per NYP

BREAKING: The head of the army says the UK's political leaders are about to start a "frank conversation" with the public about the need to prepare for war, per Sky News.

General Sir Roly Walker said every citizen will be asked to make sacrifices and to play their part in the defence of the nation.
BREAKING: President Trump puts new Russia sanctions passed by Congress on hold, saying a waiver is in the U.S. national interest.
BREAKING: Bank of America is warning that the AI boom is starting to look like a classic boom-and-bust cycle.

Real average hourly earnings are officially down 0.7% on the month, per Bloomberg.

That's the sixth straight month of decline.
BREAKING: The US has recorded its 25th straight fiscal year in a row of operating at a deficit, per CNBC
BREAKING:  Trump’s new press secretary, Katie Zacharia, was fired after less than a week on the job, per NYT
